dimensions.label: Sensing methods
dimensions.description: Sensing methods on the coded physiological measurement rows.

dimensions.label: Body sites
dimensions.description: Recorded anatomical sites; distinct coded labels are retained.

dimensions.label: Device brands
dimensions.description: Recorded brand labels, including missing-code categories.

dimensions.label: Experimental setting
dimensions.description: One recorded setting per experiment; mixed settings remain separate.

dimensions.label: Spatial typology
dimensions.description: The recorded room or activity-space typology.

dimensions.label: Manipulated domains
dimensions.description: Domains explicitly coded as manipulated; an experiment can have several.

dimensions.label: Environmental measurements
dimensions.description: Variables coded as measured, including MNR entries with unspecified placement details.

dimensions.label: Questionnaires
dimensions.description: Questionnaire types with substantive scale entries or an explicit MNR code; unclear entries are excluded.

dimensions.label: Protocol controls
dimensions.description: Protocol fields explicitly flagged Y; reporting does not establish adherence.

dimensions.label: Participant metadata
dimensions.description: Participant characteristics explicitly flagged as documented.

dimensions.label: Recruitment criteria
dimensions.description: Eligibility fields explicitly flagged Y; the direction of a criterion requires checking the source.

dimensions.label: Sex composition
dimensions.description: Composition from usable numeric male/female counts; unresolved counts remain separate.

dimensions.label: Publication period
dimensions.description: Two-year periods based on publication year, not experiment dates.

dimensions.label: Country
dimensions.description: Country labels as recorded; map-specific geographic harmonisation is not applied.

dimensions.label: Host climate
dimensions.description: Recorded Köppen classifications, retaining multiple classifications as written.

dimensions.label: Data availability
dimensions.description: Coded data-availability status; a statement does not establish usable data access.
